282:t_10:19.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Um, but can someone like me really be of any help?」

282:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! It's about the love lives of $c, after all!」

282:t_10:21.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Then that's my specialty! What's really exciting is the stage before people become a couple, right!」

282:t_10:22.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Like $$グレイス#pilot$$ and $$セイエイ$$, or $$リンクス$$ and $$ザビ$$, or $l and Miss $$西条$$...」

282:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... This time, at a certain person's request, I'm looking into how your dear Papa and Mama first got together.」

282:t_10:26.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Come to think of it, I don't know either.」

282:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's talk about something else. Point blank: who is the person who's caught your eye?」

282:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do tell me, with that cute little mouth of yours.」

282:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I could even interrogate you, you know. The nasty way, $$ＤＥＭ$$-style.」

282:t_10:31.en:
$$イアン$$
「You sexual harassment robot! If you lay a hand on $$ミレイナ$$, I won't forgive you!」

282:t_10:33.en:
$$イアン$$
「I won't have a robot like you calling me Papa!」

282:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How unreasonable! Your daughter might even fall in love with someone who isn't human someday, you know!」

282:t_10:35.en:
$$イアン$$
「As long as it isn't you, I don't care if it's a human, a robot, or anything! But you, you alone are out of the question!」

282:t_10:37.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Sigh... Once he gets like this, Papa can't be stopped...」

282:t_10:38.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Well then, today we'll mind the shop, as a special treat! Let's give it our all again today...!」

283:t_000:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Where are $$刹那$$ and $$ティエリア$$?」

283:t_000:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「They're at the base for the final adjustments on their units.」

283:t_001:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So these are the type the $$トップレス$$ people were fighting. They're definitely different from the ones we saw in the galaxy.」

283:t_001:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Either way, they're still our enemies! Give all units the order to launch!」

283:t_002:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well, well... Just when I thought we'd come back to the Solar System, what a rough welcome.」

283:t_002:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Where were you sending a transmission?」

283:t_002:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's enough, both of you, $$姫$$ and $$ニコラ$$. There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ right in front of us.」

283:t_002:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I know. Fighting them is our job.」

283:t_002:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Judging from its course, that $$ツインテール級$$ seems to be heading for the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ base.」

283:t_002:8.en:
$$シン$$
「If they take that place out now, this time we'll be stuck at Jupiter!」

283:t_002:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We defend that base no matter what.」

283:t_003:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry, you monsters. We can't let you take out that base.」

283:t_003:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I can't show anything uncool right in front of her, you know.」

283:t_003:4.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Even without anyone like that, $$赤木$$, who's always fired up, is pretty amazing in his own way, too.」

283:t_004:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$バナージ$$... Can't $$刹那$$ sortie yet?」

283:t_004:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It sounds like it'll take a little longer, so until then he's leaving it to us.」

283:t_004:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then we can't fail to live up to that expectation.」

283:t_004:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We finally made it back to the Solar System, and it'd be pointless to get taken out by $$バアル$$ now!」

283:t_004:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah! I don't know if it's some force out to wipe everything out or whatever, but don't think you can destroy us!」

283:t_004:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Don't forget there's a base behind us!」

283:t_004:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Here we come, $$宇宙怪獣$$! We won't let you have your way!」

283:t_005:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「All units, stay alert! Reinforcements are coming!」

283:t_006:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We'll have to teach them that it's pointless no matter how many of them come.」

283:t_006:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wait, $$ニコラ$$! Something else is about to happen...!」

283:t_007:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Rapid distortion of the dimensional boundary line confirmed! Something is transferring into this area!」

283:t_007:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$インベーダー#pilot$$s...!? Or the $$バジュラ$$...!?」

283:t_008:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「A unit... Or rather, it looks more like a lump of metal...」

283:t_010:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「An attack!? It looked like it bit it!?」

283:t_010:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The space monster is being eroded...!」

283:t_010:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「That Unknown... It's trying to fuse with its opponent!」

283:t_010:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Fuse...! You mean it's trying to take the other one into itself!?」

283:t_010:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like it's just like $$キラ$$ said!」

283:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it couldn't withstand that Unknown's erosion!」

283:t_012:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I wonder if they decided they couldn't take on something like that after all.」

283:t_012:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Who knows. They might have just left it for us to deal with.」

283:t_012:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Then we're the ones who have to fight those things!?」

283:t_012:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Looks like it's planning to come at us!」

283:t_012:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Its course has been determined! The Unknown's target is the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ base!」

283:t_012:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We have no choice but to intercept it.」

283:t_012:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hold on a second! How are we going to deal with their tactics!?」

283:t_012:8.en:
$$メール$$
「If we get taken in by that thing, what's going to happen to us...!?」

283:t_012:9.en:
$$レド$$
「But we have no choice but to fight... To survive...!」

283:t_012:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, we've got no choice but to do it! Steel yourselves!」

283:t_012:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「We can't let them through to the base!」

リンクス.evidence: Mileina's 「リンクス君」 for Banagher (surname Links, glossary バナージ・リンクス); same proposal as dlg_2039_00
